g.text: PipelineTmaAsync with 5 stages: two mbarrier arrays, one state per side
wait empty[index] for phase, then arrive.expect_tx(tx_count) on full[index]
TMA completes: complete_tx(bytes copied) on full[index]
one lane per consumer warp: arrive on empty[index]
State per side over seven KV tiles as (index, phase); advance() wraps index at 5 and flips phase
wrap: index back to 0, phase flipped
Producer starts at phase 1 (make_pipeline_state, Producer): a fresh barrier is in phase 0, and a wait for the
preceding phase's parity returns at once, so the first five acquires pass without a consumer. At tile 5 the
producer waits on empty[0] for phase 0, which completes only when the consumer has released tile 0.
Consumer starts at phase 0; its first wait on full[0] blocks until the producer's arrival plus the TMA
